headings: The Moon Has Opened A 48-Hour Window For You…
paragraphs: The Moon Has Opened A 48-Hour Window For You…
Right now, the Moon is sitting in her most emotionally charged position of the month.

For the next 48 hours, the energetic cords between you and the people tied to your heart — past, present, and the one still to come — are amplified. Easier to read. Easier to feel. Easier to receive from.
This is why old feelings resurface around the full moon. Why their name crosses your mind out of nowhere. Why your dreams get louder.
And there is a message waiting inside it for you — but only while the window stays open.
